'''Genetics Laboratory G-1''' was a secret [[Science/Legends|science]] facility located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was under control of the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]], who experimented on living beings to advance their own goals. The facility was overseen by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Gorima]].

==History==
At some point during the [[Galactic War]], Gorima experimented on numerous living specimens, including the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jakarro]]. The latter was later freed by a combined [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]/[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] strike team, which [[Operation on Manaan|infiltrated]] the base. During the infiltration, [[Darth Arkous|Arkous]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rian Darok|Darok]] fled the facility and launched a deep charge at it, sinking the Laboratory.
